stories.title: Haryana Assembly polls: Parties chase Dalits; voters chase papers
stories.summary: All parties are wooing Dalit voters, who constitute 21% of the Haryana electorate; Congress banks on call for change; BJP intensifies its attack; BSP, ASP, in alliance with local outfits, vie for a piece of the same pie The available reporting identifies the immediate development, but further evidence is needed to assess implementation, responses and longer-term consequences.
stories.why_it_matters: The development affects electoral competition, representation or political accountability. Its wider importance will depend on voter response, institutional follow-through and whether the competing claims produce measurable changes in participation or public policy.
stories.evidence_status: The account is based on reporting by The Hindu - States. Official claims, allegations and projections remain attributed; underlying records were not independently reviewed unless a linked report states otherwise.

stories.title: NC, PDP blame Centre for lower turnout in second phase of elections in J&K
stories.summary: NC vice-president Omar Abdullah said the Centre was at fault to project the high poll percentage in the first phase as normalcy and call it the effect of Article 370 removal. “I think the low voter turnout was the reaction to it in Srinagar,” he said.
